statement: Separate administrative shotai, immediate combat element and controlled tactical package; radio most directly enlarges the controlled package.
Three-plane shotai survives because of hierarchy/training/visual support/carrier organization, not radio alone.
Worldline likely first change is 3-plane immediate element retained but 6-plane/two-shotai controlled package becomes routine by A6M era.
Nine-plane chutai can be employed as6+3 main/reserve rather than rigid nine-plane tactical mass.
2+2 four-plane trials plausible 1940H2-1941 selected units, but require pair mutual-support doctrine beyond radio hardware.
Universal carrier four-plane cell not central by Apr29 without explicit adoption/training gate; Apr29/MI combat may accelerate it.
A12 naturally maps to two6-aircraft packages.
A15 naturally maps to6+6+3: two task packages plus one free/high/reserve shotai.
A18 maps to6+6+6 or6+6+3+3 depending escort intent.
Use 6-plane package model in A12/A15/A18 valid-release replay; later decide whether Apr29/MI lessons trigger formal 4-plane adoption.
